== 说明 ==
要使用本模板，请添加{{T|{{BASEPAGENAME}}}}模板并填写对应字段。留空的字段不会在文章中显示。本信息框模板使用[[w:Help:Infobox|Fandom的信息框语法]]。

== 语法 ==
<pre>
{{Location
 | title         = 
 | image         = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | imagecaption  = 
 | map           = [例如 "Example.jpg"]
 | mapcaption    = 
 | type          = 
 | level         = 
 | location      = 
 | inhabitants   = 
}}
</pre>

== 示例输出 ==
{{Location
 | title         = 植物岛
 | image         = Example.jpg
 | imagecaption  = 该岛
 | map           = Example.jpg
 | mapcaption    = 区域地图
 | type          = 争夺中
 | level         = 1-5
 | location      = 地球
 | inhabitants   = 跺脚人类、采蜜蜂
}}<pre>
